title: Audio Studio
summary: 96 kHz acoustic spectrum, 3D belt tuner, anomaly watch & SoundNet-2D ML
description: Audio Studio turns CardputerZero's ES8389 Hi-Fi audio codec into a pocket 96 kHz spectrum analyzer, ultrasonic detector (18-48 kHz), oscilloscope & YIN chromatic tuner, pre-trigger anomaly recorder, and on-device INT8 ML acoustics lab. Includes SoundNet-2D (28 sound classes + 32D Few-Shot custom sound enrollment), AnomalyAE-2D (DCASE convolutional autoencoder with 32-band fault heatmap), DTMF/mains-hum/T3 alarm decoders, speaker signal generator, WAV library, and opt-in stdio MCP server.
